## End of life (C1-C4) and Module D by item class

C1-C4 is split by material chemistry (Building_factors.C14_HELD_CLASSES), not by a ratio threshold: the carbon-bearing classes are held at 2025 in both bounds of the committed range; the energy part of the others takes the generic construction-stage factor of 2050 in the lower bound. Items: sums over the case-study items (data/derived/material_items.csv); weighted: the pooled class factors (as the typology factors) weighted by the Reference 2026-2050 cohort floor area by typology. CONCRETE (weighted 0.12-0.13) is in the energy part: the low A1-A3 of unreinforced low-strength in-situ concrete, not material carbon.
